versions.changelog:
- Introduced the new file-upload skill: upload local images, videos, and audio to cloud storage and get public URLs.
- Added .gitignore and README.md for improved repo management and onboarding.
- SKILL.md has been updated with expanded usage details, new capabilities, and more precise API parameter requirements.
- Unified authentication: all skills now require the secretKey in request headers (with updated notes on body compatibility).
- Removed deprecated skill-card.md file.

- Documentation files skill-card.md and skills/file-upload/SKILL.md were removed.
- No changes made to source code or functionality.
- No user-facing impact; this update is documentation/metadata only.

- Added new skills: ai-writing-assist, gen-hot-image, gen-hot-video, and generate-video, expanding supported AI capabilities to include writing assistance and video/image generation.
- Updated SKILL.md to include new skills, their descriptions, capabilities, and API endpoints.
- Consolidated and reorganized documentation for easier reference and unified format.
- Removed outdated documentation files (skill-card.md, skills.md).

Initial release: major refactor to focus on Flyelep AI image and e-commerce poster skills.

- Added 12 new skills centered on AI图片、海报生成及图片增强，集成Flyelep API，包括generate-poster、ai-image-matting、image-enlarge、scene-replace等
- 移除了原有审核、agent-transcript等非Flyelep企业相关技能与文档（共移除43项）
- 新增简明中文版总技能说明（skills.md），并补充各技能目录下独立SKILL.md
- 提供OpenClaw、Claude Code等平台的安装/对接说明
- 统一环境与API接入要求，详细列举参数和接口映射规则
